clauses.reason: The lead scope contains the authority recital and Section 1, which closes all Executive departments and agencies and excuses employees from duty for the last half of the scheduled workday on Christmas Eve, December 24, 1987, except as Section 2 allows. The provision concerns December 24, 1987 alone and was performed (or, for Section 4, had nothing left to limit) when that day ended, so its first end is 1987-12-24, recorded inclusive (the order operates through the day; the exclusive reading, ending when the day begins, cannot apply to a command about that day). The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.

Section 2 lets the heads of Executive departments and agencies decide that certain offices and installations stay open and certain employees remain on duty for the full scheduled workday on December 24, 1987 for reasons of national security or defense or other essential public reasons. The provision concerns December 24, 1987 alone and was performed (or, for Section 4, had nothing left to limit) when that day ended, so its first end is 1987-12-24, recorded inclusive (the order operates through the day; the exclusive reading, ending when the day begins, cannot apply to a command about that day). The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.

Section 3 provides that Thursday, December 24, 1987 is to be considered as falling within the scope of Executive Order No. 11582 and of 5 U.S.C. 5546 and 6103(b) and other similar statutes insofar as they relate to the pay and leave of employees of the United States. The provision concerns December 24, 1987 alone and was performed (or, for Section 4, had nothing left to limit) when that day ended, so its first end is 1987-12-24, recorded inclusive (the order operates through the day; the exclusive reading, ending when the day begins, cannot apply to a command about that day). The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.

Section 4 states that the order applies to Federal departments and agencies only and is not intended to direct or otherwise implicate departments or agencies of State or local governments. It limits the reach of Sections 1 through 3 and has no operation apart from them. The provision concerns December 24, 1987 alone and was performed (or, for Section 4, had nothing left to limit) when that day ended, so its first end is 1987-12-24, recorded inclusive (the order operates through the day; the exclusive reading, ending when the day begins, cannot apply to a command about that day). The packet lookup of held texts citing this order by number found none.
